messages:
jin: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to tighten up the supported-regions table and add a short data-residency note for EU/APAC customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

sara: Thanks. Can you add one sentence clarifying "data residency" here means customer-configured processing/storage locality (no cross-region replication unless explicitly configured)? Legal needs that.

mike: I pushed an SDK snippet change to the PR to show a region flag + optional residency setting. Example included. PTAL — want to make sure snippet style matches other guides.

ashley: Quick legal guidance: avoid the word "guarantee". Use phrasing like "processed and stored within the selected region(s) under contractual terms". Also add a pointer to KMS/HSM guidance for encryption-at-rest.

jin: Good call. I'll swap the language. Also thinking we should add a short migration note for Dedicated customers (how to pin region and what default behavior is for older agents).

sara: Migration note should list env var + CLI flag folks need to change. Example: RW_REGION and `redwood deploy --region`. Also add a one-line fallback behavior: older clients default to the global namespace.

mike: Here's the JS snippet I added to the PR (copied from branch):

```js
// Node SDK example (shows region + residency)
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  region: "eu-west-1", // cloud region for routing
  dataResidency: "eu" // optional: residency preference for storage/processing
});
const res = await client.generate({ model: "redwood-1" });
```

sara: Nice, that covers both routing and residency. Could you also add a short curl example for infra teams who prefer it?

mike: Yep — added a curl snippet too in the PR.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — labels applied: [docs] [legal-review] [region-updates]

ashley: Reviewed the copy. Please replace "we guarantee" with "we process and store" in the second paragraph and add the KMS link: https://internal.redwood/security/kms-integration. After that I'm fine with signoff.

jin: Done — pushed a small commit that updates the sentence and adds the KMS link. Also created a "What's changed" bullet in the migration guide.

sara: Can one of you confirm the table row for APAC includes the right region code for Singapore and Tokyo? I noticed earlier it said "ap-south-1" which is India.

mike: Fixed the table; changed to ap-southeast-1 (SG) and ap-northeast-1 (JP). Also added a short footnote about future region expansion schedule.

jin: Quick style question — for the SDK param name should we prefer `regionCode: 'eu'` or `region: 'eu-west-1'`? Right now the snippet uses both `region` (cloud region) and `dataResidency` (eu|us|apac).

mike: I prefer explicit cloud region in `region` and a short `dataResidency` enum. Keeps routing and residency separate. I'll add inline comments to the snippet to make that clear.

sara: LGTM from product side :thumbsup: Once legal signoff is in, I'll merge and backport to v1.2 docs branch.

docs-bot: PR #842 merged into main by sara — changelog entry auto-created: "docs: clarify region availability & data residency; update SDK snippets"

jin: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short release note for the Console team so they can surface the new copy in the region selector help text.
